notes: §1985:XII.2.3 SR6 (kb/Work PB5418, landed): word-1 or word-2 'may be any single COBOL word except' COPY. The exclusion half: COPY as word-1 or word-2 draws COBOL7006 (1985-SR-XII_2_3-6). The admission half: CopyProcessor reads the REPLACING operands by position, operand BY operand, so ReadOperand takes a BY where an operand stands as the operand, and ParseReplacingOperands opens the LEADING / TRAILING partial-word phrase only where ==partial-word-1== follows, so LEADING and TRAILING are word operands otherwise. Witness pb5418-replacing-reserved-words: REPLACING BY BY "B" TRAILING BY "D" LEADING BY "F" prints AB, CD, EF at 85 (and at 2002 and 2014, by hand).

next.reason: 1985: "Word-1 or word-2 may be any single COBOL word except 'COPY'."; 2023: "No word-1/word-2 operand; the 7.2.3.3 syntax rules cover only pseudo-text-1/2 and partial-word-1/2 for REPLACING". The 2023 COPY syntax rules define only pseudo-text and partial-word REPLACING operands, so the word operand and its COPY restriction are gone. GR-13 is a different, broader rule.
